title: Staff
description: The employees of each branch: file number, position, agreed pay, what we owe them (or they owe) and the goods they took. Salaries are paid in "Payroll".

columns.name: Name
columns.balanceHint: What we owe them (unpaid salary) or they owe us (advances)

status.advanced: Advance of {{amount}} to {{name}} recorded: it left the till and is deducted from the next payroll.

form.description: File data and pay. Not the legal payroll (contributions, official payslip): the accountant keeps doing that.
form.roleHint: Positions are managed in Lookup tables → Positions.
form.payHint: The base amount proposed in every payroll of its frequency. Overtime, bonuses, SAC, etc. are added in each payroll.
form.takesGoods: Takes goods (sold at the POS on account, deducted from the salary)
form.takesGoodsHint: A customer "Last, First (personal)" is created to sell to at the POS on account. At payroll, what they owe is deducted with the discount you decide then.

errors.name: Enter last and first name.
errors.salary: The pay is an amount with up to two decimals (or empty).
errors.file: The file number is a whole number above zero.

advance.title: Advance to {{name}}
advance.description: The money leaves the treasury account you choose and stays on the employee's account: the next payroll deducts it.
advance.conceptPlaceholder: E.g.: on account of October's salary

errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, with up to two decimals.
errors.account: Choose the account the money comes from.

errors.load: The staff could not be loaded.
errors.save: It could not be saved. Try again.

codes.file-number-in-use: Another employee has that file number.
codes.account-not-found: That treasury account does not exist.
